deadline.value: The Computer Science Ph.D. page does not state an application deadline.

gre_subject.value: ETS does not offer a GRE Subject Test in Computer Science.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The Computer Science Ph.D. page does not state whether pre-admission supervisor contact or agreement is required.

funding.value: The Computer Science Ph.D. page does not state doctoral fellowship or assistantship funding terms (departmental teaching fellowships page applies to M.S. Computer Science thesis students).

entry_route.value: Students may enter directly with a bachelor's degree (72 semester hours of graduate work) or with a related master's degree (42 semester hours beyond the master's).
entry_route.quote: Students possessing a bachelor's degree will be required to complete a minimum of 72 semester hours of graduate-level work. Students possessing a master’s degree in a related field will be required to complete a minimum of 42 semester hours of graduate-level work beyond their master's degree in addition to meeting other Ph.D. requirements (outlined below).
